measurements.unit: UTF-8 JSON field bytes; these are not tokenizer output or billing

notes: The CLI common-tools run matches the previous comparison restrictions. The default-tools run removes only the explicit tool allowlist.

Synthetic rules contain one marker per file. In native requests, the extra AGENTS.md marker is in a system-reminder block labelled Result of calling the Read tool, distinct from the explicit project instruction block.
Changing an @AGENTS.md line to literal AGENTS.md removes the extra block. Two equal imports in the same input produced one additional file read; it recurred on the next turn.
